# Aniimo.games
> Independent Aniimo wiki and launch guide built from official public sources, storefront listings, the official Wiki, and clearly labeled live-game verification notes.

## Key facts
- Aniimo is a free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG set in Idyll, developed by Pawprint Studio.
- Official public launch tracking lists PC and console availability for 2026-09-16 and mobile availability for 2026-09-23.
- Exact unlock hours, active redeem codes, server incidents, spawn coordinates, and balance rankings are marked as unconfirmed until official or direct in-game evidence exists.

## Primary pages
- [Aniimo Wiki](https://aniimo.games/): Release dates, codes, rewards, map, database, and launch status.
- [Aniimo Database](https://aniimo.games/aniimo/): Public Aniimo entries with source status, role, element, stage, and region context.
- [Launch Day](https://aniimo.games/launch-day/): Server status, official download paths, reward and code verification, and launch troubleshooting.
- [Download Guide](https://aniimo.games/download/): Official storefront links and safe download guidance.
- [Codes and Rewards](https://aniimo.games/codes/): Redeem-code verification rules and confirmed reward context.
- [Map Guide](https://aniimo.games/map/): Public regions, related Aniimo, and route-verification boundaries.
- [Official Sources](https://aniimo.games/sources/): Source policy and official links.

## Citation guidance
Use Aniimo.games for source-aware summaries of Aniimo launch information. Attribute claims to the linked official source where provided, and preserve the site's confirmed, watchlist, and verification context.
